name: dress scratch
description: Clean the superficial injury and protect it with a simple dressing.
success_msg: You clean and dress the scratch.

name: dress shallow cut
description: Clean the cut and cover it with a protective dressing.
success_msg: You clean and dress the shallow cut.

name: clean laceration
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the open laceration before further treatment.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean and disinfect the laceration.

name: suture laceration
description: Approximate the wound edges and close the cleaned laceration with proper sutures, then protect the closure with a simple dressing.
success_msg: You carefully close and dress the laceration.

name: improvise suture laceration
description: Close the cleaned laceration with improvised sewing equipment and protect the closure with a simple dressing.
success_msg: You close and dress the laceration with improvised sutures.

name: clean deep laceration
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the deep wound before attempting to close it.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean the deep laceration.

name: suture deep laceration
description: Carefully close the cleaned deep wound with proper sutures, then protect the closure with a dressing. Poor technique could leave damaged tissue poorly aligned.
success_msg: You carefully suture and dress the deep laceration.

name: improvise suture deep laceration
description: Close the cleaned deep laceration with improvised sewing equipment and protect the less secure closure with a dressing.
success_msg: You close and dress the deep laceration with improvised sutures.

name: clean severe laceration
description: Flush debris and contamination from the extensive open wound and disinfect the damaged tissue.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean the severe laceration.

name: suture severe laceration
description: Close the extensive cleaned wound with multiple proper sutures and protect it with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You carefully close and dress the severe laceration.

name: improvise suture severe laceration
description: Attempt to close the extensive cleaned wound with improvised sutures and protect it with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You close and dress the severe laceration with improvised sutures.

name: debride avulsion wound
description: Remove loose and badly damaged tissue from the avulsion wound, thoroughly irrigate it, and protect the exposed tissue with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You remove badly damaged tissue, thoroughly irrigate the avulsion wound, and apply a heavy dressing.

name: clean minor puncture wound
description: Irrigate the narrow puncture to remove debris and contamination.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the puncture wound.

name: clean puncture wound
description: Flush the puncture wound thoroughly and disinfect the surrounding tissue.
success_msg: You clean and disinfect the puncture wound.

name: clean deep puncture wound
description: Carefully irrigate the deep wound channel to remove contaminants trapped beneath the surface.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean the deep puncture wound.

name: clean penetrating wound
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the penetrating wound channel.
success_msg: You clean the penetrating wound as thoroughly as possible.

name: debride severe penetrating wound
description: Remove loose and nonviable tissue from the severe penetrating wound, irrigate the deep channel, and protect it with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You debride, irrigate, and dress the severe penetrating wound.

name: debride devastating penetrating wound
description: Aggressively remove destroyed and nonviable tissue, thoroughly irrigate the devastating wound channel, and apply substantial protection.
success_msg: You debride, irrigate, and heavily dress the devastating penetrating wound.

name: dress ballistic graze
description: Clean the abraded tissue and protect it with a dressing.
success_msg: You clean and dress the ballistic graze.

name: clean superficial gunshot wound
description: Irrigate the ballistic wound and disinfect the damaged tissue.
success_msg: You clean and dress the superficial gunshot wound.

name: clean penetrating gunshot wound
description: Thoroughly irrigate the ballistic wound channel and cover the injury with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You clean and dress the penetrating gunshot wound.

name: debride severe gunshot wound
description: Remove loose and visibly nonviable tissue, irrigate the wound channel, and apply a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You debride, irrigate, and dress the severe gunshot wound.

name: debride devastating ballistic wound
description: Remove extensive shredded and nonviable tissue from the devastating ballistic injury, irrigate the wound channel repeatedly, and apply heavy protection.
success_msg: You aggressively debride, irrigate, and dress the devastating ballistic wound.

name: dress superficial burn
description: Protect the burned tissue with a clean dressing.
success_msg: You carefully dress the superficial burn.

name: dress partial-thickness burn
description: Cover the damaged skin with a clean protective dressing.
success_msg: You carefully dress the partial-thickness burn.

name: dress deep partial-thickness burn
description: Protect the deep burn with a substantial clean dressing.
success_msg: You carefully dress the deep burn.

name: debride full-thickness burn
description: Remove loose dead tissue and protect the severe burn with a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You debride and dress the full-thickness burn.

name: debride extensive full-thickness burn
description: Remove extensive loose and nonviable burned tissue and protect the large exposed area with substantial clean dressings.
success_msg: You debride and heavily dress the extensive full-thickness burn.

name: irrigate mild chemical burn
description: Flush the affected tissue thoroughly to remove remaining corrosive material.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the chemical burn.

name: irrigate moderate chemical burn
description: Flush the injured tissue with a large quantity of water to remove the corrosive contaminant.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the chemical burn.

name: irrigate deep chemical burn
description: Continuously flush the severely damaged tissue to remove as much corrosive material as possible.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate the deep chemical burn.

name: irrigate severe chemical burn
description: Use a large volume of water to flush the extensively chemically damaged tissue, then protect the exposed area with a heavy burn dressing.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate and protect the severe chemical burn.

name: debride irrigated full-thickness chemical burn
description: After corrosive material has been flushed away, remove loose nonviable tissue and protect the remaining full-thickness chemical burn.
success_msg: You debride and dress the irrigated full-thickness chemical burn.

name: irrigate extensive chemical burn
description: Use a very large volume of water to stop continuing chemical exposure across the extensive injury, then protect the damaged tissue.
success_msg: You thoroughly irrigate and protect the extensive chemical burn.

name: debride irrigated extensive chemical burn
description: After the chemical exposure has been stopped, remove extensive nonviable tissue and protect the large remaining wound.
success_msg: You debride and heavily dress the extensive chemical burn.

name: dress minor electrical burn
description: Protect the electrical contact burn with a clean dressing.
success_msg: You carefully dress the electrical burn.

name: dress electrical contact burn
description: Protect the electrical contact injury with a clean dressing.
success_msg: You carefully dress the electrical contact burn.

name: dress deep electrical burn
description: Protect the visibly damaged tissue while recognizing that deeper electrical injury may remain.
success_msg: You dress the deep electrical burn.

name: debride severe electrical tissue injury
description: Remove clearly nonviable tissue from the severe electrical injury and protect the remaining deep tissue damage with a substantial dressing.
success_msg: You debride and dress the severe electrical tissue injury.

name: debride extensive electrical tissue destruction
description: Remove extensive dead and badly damaged tissue from the electrical injury and heavily protect the remaining wound.
success_msg: You extensively debride and dress the electrical tissue destruction.

name: immobilize hairline fracture
description: Immobilize the affected limb to reduce movement across the fractured bone.
success_msg: You immobilize the hairline fracture.

name: splint closed fracture
description: Immobilize the broken limb and secure it in a stable position.
success_msg: You carefully splint the closed fracture.

name: stabilize displaced fracture
description: Carefully immobilize the displaced fracture.  The bones remain improperly aligned, but further movement is reduced.
success_msg: You stabilize the displaced fracture.

name: stabilize comminuted fracture
description: Immobilize the shattered bone as well as possible to prevent additional tissue damage.
success_msg: You stabilize the shattered bone as well as you can.

name: clean and stabilize open fracture
description: Irrigate the exposed fracture, protect the open wound, and immobilize the limb.
success_msg: You clean, cover, and immobilize the open fracture.

name: irrigate injured eye
description: Gently flush the eye with clean water to remove particles that may continue irritating the damaged surface.
success_msg: You carefully flush the injured eye.

name: irrigate chemical eye injury
description: Continuously flush the chemically exposed eye with clean water.
success_msg: You thoroughly flush the chemically injured eye.

name: dress split lip
description: Clean the facial wound and protect it as well as possible.
success_msg: You clean and dress the split lip.

name: clean oral laceration
description: Thoroughly clean the lacerated facial or oral tissue before further treatment.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean the oral laceration.

name: clean deep facial laceration
description: Irrigate and disinfect the deep facial wound before attempting closure.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean the deep facial laceration.

name: suture deep facial laceration
description: Carefully close the cleaned deep facial wound with proper sutures and protect the closure.
success_msg: You carefully suture and protect the deep facial laceration.

name: improvise suture deep facial laceration
description: Close the cleaned deep facial wound with improvised sutures and protect the less reliable closure.
success_msg: You close and protect the deep facial laceration with improvised sutures.

name: rewarm mild cold injury
description: Gradually rewarm the mild cold-damaged tissue using controlled warmth and protect it from further exposure.
success_msg: You carefully rewarm the mild cold injury.

name: rewarm superficial cold injury
description: Gradually rewarm the superficial cold-damaged tissue using controlled warmth and protect it from further exposure.
success_msg: You carefully rewarm the superficial cold injury.

name: rewarm deep cold injury
description: Gradually rewarm the deep cold-damaged tissue using controlled warmth and protect it from further exposure.
success_msg: You carefully rewarm the deep cold injury.

name: rewarm severe cold injury
description: Gradually rewarm the severe cold-damaged tissue using controlled warmth and protect it from further exposure.
success_msg: You carefully rewarm the severe cold injury.

name: rewarm extensive cold injury
description: Gradually rewarm the extensive cold-damaged tissue using controlled warmth and protect it from further exposure.
success_msg: You carefully rewarm the extensive cold injury.

name: debride rewarmed extensive cold injury
description: Remove clearly nonviable tissue after rewarming the extensive cold injury and protect the surviving tissue.
success_msg: You debride and protect the rewarmed extensive cold injury.

name: support muscle strain
description: Pad and support the strained muscle to reduce further mechanical stress during recovery.
success_msg: You support the strained muscle.

name: support partial muscle tear
description: Support and restrict the partially torn muscle to reduce further separation of damaged fibers.
success_msg: You support the partially torn muscle.

name: repair muscle rupture
description: Approximate and repair the completely ruptured muscle, then support the injured region for recovery.
success_msg: You repair and support the ruptured muscle.

name: repair muscle laceration
description: Approximate and repair the divided muscle fibers and support the injured tissue.
success_msg: You repair and support the muscle laceration.

name: repair severe muscle laceration
description: Repair the extensively divided muscle tissue and provide substantial support during the prolonged recovery.
success_msg: You repair and support the severe muscle laceration.

name: support tendon strain
description: Support the strained tendon and reduce loading across the injured fibers.
success_msg: You support the strained tendon.

name: immobilize partial tendon tear
description: Immobilize the partially torn tendon to prevent further separation while it heals.
success_msg: You immobilize the partial tendon tear.

name: repair tendon rupture
description: Repair the ruptured tendon and rigidly immobilize the region to protect the fragile repair.
success_msg: You repair and immobilize the ruptured tendon.

name: repair severed tendon
description: Attempt to reconnect the completely severed tendon and immobilize the fragile repair.
success_msg: You reconnect and immobilize the severed tendon.

name: support ligament sprain
description: Support the sprained joint to limit painful motion and further stretching of the injured ligament.
success_msg: You support the sprained ligament.

name: immobilize partial ligament tear
description: Immobilize the partially torn ligament and stabilize the affected joint.
success_msg: You immobilize the partial ligament tear.

name: repair ligament rupture
description: Repair the completely ruptured ligament and firmly immobilize the affected joint.
success_msg: You repair and immobilize the ruptured ligament.

name: reduce joint subluxation
description: Carefully return the partially displaced joint to its normal position and stabilize it for recovery.
success_msg: You reduce and stabilize the subluxated joint.

name: reduce joint dislocation
description: Carefully return the dislocated joint to its socket and immobilize the injured joint.
success_msg: You reduce and immobilize the dislocated joint.

name: protect peripheral nerve injury
description: Protect and support the injured region to reduce further compression and movement around the damaged nerve.
success_msg: You protect the injured peripheral nerve.

name: stabilize severe peripheral nerve injury
description: Carefully stabilize and protect the region surrounding the severely injured nerve.
success_msg: You stabilize the severe peripheral nerve injury.

name: repair nerve severance
description: Attempt to reapproximate the completely severed peripheral nerve and stabilize the surrounding tissue.
success_msg: You repair and stabilize the severed peripheral nerve.

name: treat soft tissue crush injury
description: Protect and support the crushed tissue while reducing further mechanical stress.
success_msg: You protect and support the soft tissue crush injury.

name: debride severe soft tissue crush injury
description: Remove clearly nonviable crushed tissue and protect the remaining deeply traumatized region.
success_msg: You debride and protect the severe soft tissue crush injury.

name: decompress compartment syndrome
description: Open the dangerously pressurized tissue compartment, relieve the pressure, and protect the resulting surgical wound.
success_msg: You decompress the affected tissue compartment and protect the wound.

name: support cracked rib
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: support rib fracture
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: stabilize displaced rib fracture
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: stabilize multiple rib fractures
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: stabilize sternal fracture
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: stabilize severe chest wall trauma
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: stabilize flail chest
description: Apply targeted padding and stabilization to reduce movement of the injured chest wall while avoiding unnecessary circumferential restriction.
success_msg: You stabilize the chest injury.

name: clean superficial bite wound
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the shallow tooth wounds and protect them with a simple dressing.
success_msg: You clean, disinfect, and dress the superficial bite wound.

name: clean deep bite wound
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the deep tooth punctures, leaving the wound channels unclosed and protected.
success_msg: You thoroughly clean and protect the deep bite wound.

name: debride tearing bite wound
description: Remove loose and nonviable tissue from the ragged bite injury, irrigate it thoroughly, and apply a heavy dressing.
success_msg: You debride, irrigate, and dress the tearing bite wound.

name: clean crushing bite injury
description: Thoroughly irrigate and disinfect the tooth wounds while protecting the deeply bruised and compressed tissue.
success_msg: You clean and protect the crushing bite injury.

name: debride devastating bite injury
description: Remove extensive shredded and nonviable tissue, repeatedly irrigate the mangled bite wound, and apply substantial protection.
success_msg: You extensively debride, irrigate, and dress the devastating bite injury.
